_doc: Kernel families (arch025 N14): each family's fragments, per architecture, compile alone with only the fragments of their declared deps (tools/gates/kernel_iso_check.py). Headers a fragment includes (kernels/shared/*.h, kernel_args.h, iq_tables.h, ...) belong to the includer. modules.json kernels.<name> rows use the same paths.

kernels.common.desc: smoke kernel, helpers, quant block decoders, packed scales, warp / block reductions

kernels.gemv.desc: decode matvec: f32 / f16 activations, int8 GEMV (grouped ABI), multi-row, WMMA mid-batch, gfx1151 units / Q6_K

kernels.gemm.desc: prefill GEMM (WMMA f16), small-batch GEMM, MXFP4 x fp8 GEMM, gemv_h (precise f16-activation decode / verify matmul on the small-batch stages)

kernels.gdn.desc: Gated DeltaNet: decode fusions, per-token / chunked / WMMA / strix prefill, sequential scan

kernels.norm.desc: get_rows, norms, rope, elementwise, prefill activation fusions, WMMA probes, requant

kernels.attn.desc: paged KV (kv_store), decode / split / prefill attention, attn_ws4 (gfx1151); argmax rides in misc_kv_argmax.hip

kernels.moe.desc: mixture of experts: route, gather, expert GEMV / GEMM, MXFP4 experts, precise f32 experts

kernels.sample.desc: token tables, greedy / draft picks, 2-bit MTP draft head, sampling candidates, speculative sampling

kernels.vision.desc: vision encoder kernels (Qwen3-VL ViT): one source, its own code object per architecture (cmake/vision.cmake), loaded only when an image arrives; not part of the whirl_kernels translation unit, so it compiles alone
